title: Marascos, Vaswanis named 2027 Paul Harris Fellows by Laredo Gateway Rotary Club
excerpt: Mike and Danielle Marasco and Shashi and Priya Vaswani were named 2027 Paul Harris Fellows by the Laredo Gateway Rotary Club for their community work — from McDonald's literacy efforts and Coffee with a Cop to youth soccer and scholarships.
content:
The Laredo Gateway Rotary Club has named Mike and Danielle Marasco and Shashi and Priya Vaswani as its 2027 Paul Harris Fellows, recognizing the two couples for their community involvement and support of local projects, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

The Paul Harris Fellow distinction, established by Rotary International in 1957, honors people who contribute — or have contributions made in their name — of $1,000 or more to The Rotary Foundation, which supports humanitarian and educational programs around the world. The club's formal fellowship dinner is scheduled for Jan. 21 at the Laredo Country Club.

The Marascos operate McDonald's of Laredo. The club cited their work in education, literacy, first-responder support and community-police engagement, including books and fruit with Happy Meals to promote literacy and healthy eating, scholarships for student employees, partnerships with local schools, and Coffee with a Cop events with the Laredo Police Department. The city recognized the couple for community service in 2017, and the Laredo Chamber of Commerce named them its 2025 Business Persons of the Year. Danielle Marasco is a second-generation McDonald's owner-operator and president of the National Franchisee Leadership Alliance.

The Vaswanis are longtime owners of the La Quinta Inn & Suites Laredo Airport and founded the Laredo Heat Youth Soccer Club in 2004, giving young athletes a chance to play competitive soccer and pursue athletic and educational goals. The club cited their support for youth soccer facilities and scholarships. TAMIU has documented their support for soccer facility improvements, and a 2008 Congressional Record entry recognized their efforts. Shashi Vaswani is president and Priya Vaswani vice president of the soccer club.

The Laredo Gateway Rotary Club was founded in 1987, and its annual recognition event dates to the 1990s. The club is led by president Hector Alaniz.

Sources: Laredo Morning Times, Nov. 11, 2026; lmtonline.com.
